title: Grand Moff Tarkin
franchise: Rogue One: A Star Wars story
description: Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin was an ambitious veteran of the Clone Wars and close confidant of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine. He had no problems playing the politics of the Empire and jockeyed for control of military power, including the Death Star, which he oversaw construction of shortly after the Empire's creation, believing that fear of its superiority could keep the galaxy in check under the Emperor's regime.
